'''2017 MPC John Anderson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[John Anderson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
